title.zh: 将布拉干省Sta. Maria市镇的Sta. Maria农业工业中学更名为Sta. Maria国立中学，为此修订第8397号共和国法的法案

text.en:
Section 1 of Republic Act No. 8397 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SECTION 1. There shall be established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in the Municipality of Sta. Maria, Province of Bulacan to be known as the Sta. Maria National High School."
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
